title: Rory and the Starlit Arch
verses:
The moon floated high over valley and hill,
As Rory walked slowly through tall silver grass.
The night in the forest was tender and still,
To watch the soft shadows of evening time pass.

Then Ricky bounced up with a nod of his head,
To show them a path where the blue flowers grow.
"Come follow the trail to a soft mossy bed,"
Said Tilly, her gentle voice quiet and low.

Now Benny stepped forward to clear off the ground,
Where Nia flew down from the canopy high.
Psittaco was chirping a sleepy old sound,
While stars started filling the velvet-black sky.

They gathered together beneath a great arch,
Where ferns rustled soft in a lullaby breeze.
As moonlight lit up every willow and larch,
Contentment came down on the slumbering trees.

Psittaco was rested on Nia's warm wing,
While Ricky leaned close unto Rory to rest.
The crickets began in the darkness to sing,
As night settled over the sleepy green nest.

Now Tilly yawned wide as she closed her sweet eyes,
And Benny breathed out with a gentle deep sigh.
Content in the glow of the dark starlit skies,
The forest sang low in a soft lullaby.
